title: Imfihlakalo Yesihlalo Sobukhosi Esikude
intro: Inkosi enamandla, ebusiswe ngokubusa okungavamile, yabhekana nenselele engavamile ehilela indlovukazi evela ezweni elikude. Inkosi yayifuna ukukhombisa amandla nokuhlakanipha kwaphezulu, iqala isenzakalo esimangalisayo esasiphikisana nemithetho yesikhathi nendawo. Ungakwazi yini ukuthola imininingwane yalesi senzakalo esimangalisayo?
clues: Umbusi wanikwa amandla amakhulu, okuhlanganisa nokulawula izidalwa ezingabonakali kanye nekhono lokuyala imimoya.
Lo mbusi wathola izindaba zendlovukazi ecebile eyayikhulekela ilanga, wabe esenquma ukuyimema enkantolo.
Ngaphambi kokufika kwendlovukazi, umbusi waveza isifiso sokuletha isihlalo sakhe sobukhosi esihle kakhulu esivela embusweni wakhe okude.
Ijini elinamandla lazinikela ukulithatha ngaphambi kokuba umbusi asukume emkhandlwini wakhe.
Nokho, umuntu onolwazi olujulile lwemiBhalo Engcwele wanikeza ukufundwa okusheshayo nakakhulu, waqeda umsebenzi ngokuphazima kweso.
Lapho ifika, umbusi wayala ukuba into ishintshwe ukuze kuhlolwe ukuhlakanipha nokuqonda kwendlovukazi lapho ekugcineni ifika esigodlweni.
verse: It was said to her, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace paved with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds." (An-Naml 27:44)
arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
